description: On desktop, the app's own page may show the folder picker, ask where Documents is, show the picker for the place a new workspace goes in and make a new workspace folder there (create_workspace_folder, only in Documents or a folder the person chose that session, never one that exists), look at what is in a folder of that name there by its names only (probe_workspace_folder), open one that exists after the shell itself asks the person to trust it (open_workspace_folder), reopen or forget a folder the person picked before, and keep trust records in the profile through pick_folder, reopen_folder, forget_folder and the trust_* commands (trust_folders_found says whether a trusted folder is still there), keep the instructions a person trusted for each agent through the instruction_trust_* commands (instruction_trust_save asks the person itself first, naming the agent and the files that changed), and ask where each connector's program is (command_paths), which the trust check fingerprints. A grant opens a folder only when the person picked it or said yes to the shell's own question (crates/trust-grant). It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no trust. Android has no folder picker.
